shloka_text: तथोक्तवति रामे तु भरते च महात्मनि । लक्ष्मणो ऽथ शुभं वाक्यमुवाच रघुनन्दनम् ।। 7.84.1 ।।
transliteration: tathoktavati rāme tu bharate ca mahātmani | lakṣmaṇo 'tha śubhaṃ vākyamuvāca raghunandanam || 7.84.1 ||
translation: तथोक्तवति when thus spoken, रामे by Rama, तु indeed, भरते by Bharata, च and, महात्मनि the great-souled, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, अथ then, शुभम् auspicious, वाक्यम् words, उवाच spoke, रघुनन्दनम् to Rama, the delight of the Raghus.
explanation: After Rama and the great-souled Bharata had spoken, Lakshmana then addressed Rama, the delight of the Raghus, with auspicious words.
comments: Lakshmana proposes instead the Ashvamedha, the all-purifying sacrifice by which Indra was once cleansed of brahmin-slaughter -- and he begins the tale of the mighty, righteous Daitya Vritra, who, ruling the earth in prosperity, took to severe penance, so alarming the gods that Indra appealed to Vishnu to slay him.

shloka_text: अश्वमेधो महायज्ञः पावनः सर्वपाप्मनाम् । पावनस्तव दुर्धर्षो रोचतां रघुनन्दन ।। 7.84.2 ।।
transliteration: aśvamedho mahāyajñaḥ pāvanaḥ sarvapāpmanām | pāvanastava durdharṣo rocatāṃ raghunandana || 7.84.2 ||
translation: अश्वमेधः The Ashwamedha, महायज्ञः a great sacrifice, पावनः purifier, सर्वपाप्मनाम् of all sins, पावनः a purifier, तव for you, दुर्धर्षः unconquerable, रोचताम् may it be pleasing, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus.
explanation: O delight of the Raghus, may the Ashwamedha, a great sacrifice and purifier of all sins, which is a purifier for you, the unconquerable one, be pleasing to you.

shloka_text: श्रूयते हि पुरावृत्तं वासवे सुमहात्मनि । ब्रह्महत्यावृतः शक्रो हयमेधेन पावितः ।। 7.84.3 ।।
transliteration: śrūyate hi purāvṛttaṃ vāsave sumahātmani | brahmahatyāvṛtaḥ śakro hayamedhena pāvitaḥ || 7.84.3 ||
translation: श्रूयते it is heard, हि indeed, पुरावृत्तम् an ancient event, वासवे regarding Indra, सुमहात्मनि the very great-souled, ब्रह्महत्यावृतः afflicted by the sin of Brahman-slaughter, शक्रः Indra, हयमेधेन by the Ashwamedha, पावितः was purified.
explanation: Indeed, it is heard that in an ancient event, the very great-souled Indra, afflicted by the sin of Brahman-slaughter, was purified by the Ashwamedha sacrifice.

shloka_text: पुरा किल महाबाहो देवासुरसमागमे । वृत्रो नाम महानासीद्दैतेयो लोकसम्मतः ।। 7.84.4 ।।
transliteration: purā kila mahābāho devāsurasamāgame | vṛtro nāma mahānāsīddaiteyo lokasammataḥ || 7.84.4 ||
translation: पुरा formerly, किल indeed, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, देवासुरसमागमे in the encounter between gods and asuras, वृत्रः Vritra, नाम named, महान् a great one, आसीत् was, दैतेयः a Daitya, लोकसम्मतः renowned in the world.
explanation: O mighty-armed one, it is said that formerly, during the conflict between gods and asuras, there was a great Daitya named Vritra, renowned throughout the world.

shloka_text: विस्तीर्णो योजनशतमुच्छ्रितस्त्रिगुणं ततः । अनुरागेण लोकांस्त्रीन्स्नेहात्पश्यति सर्वतः ।। 7.84.5 ।।
transliteration: vistīrṇo yojanaśatamucchritastriguṇaṃ tataḥ | anurāgeṇa lokāṃstrīnsnehātpaśyati sarvataḥ || 7.84.5 ||
translation: विस्तीर्णः extended, योजनशतम् a hundred yojanas, उच्छ्रितः tall, त्रिगुणम् three times, ततः than that, अनुरागेण with affection, लोकान् worlds, त्रीन् three, स्नेहात् out of love, पश्यति he saw, सर्वतः everywhere.
explanation: He was a hundred yojanas wide and three times that in height, and he regarded all three worlds everywhere with affection and love.

shloka_text: धर्मज्ञश्च कृतज्ञश्च बुद्ध्या च परिनिष्ठितः । शशास पृथिवीं स्फीतां धर्मेण सुसमाहितः ।। 7.84.6 ।।
transliteration: dharmajñaśca kṛtajñaśca buddhyā ca pariniṣṭhitaḥ | śaśāsa pṛthivīṃ sphītāṃ dharmeṇa susamāhitaḥ || 7.84.6 ||
translation: धर्मज्ञः righteous, च and, कृतज्ञः grateful, च and, बुद्ध्या with intellect, च and, परिनिष्ठितः perfected, शशास ruled, पृथिवीम् the earth, स्फीताम् prosperous, धर्मेण with righteousness, सुसमाहितः perfectly attentive.
explanation: He, being righteous, grateful, and perfected in intellect, ruled the vast and prosperous earth with perfect attention to dharma.

shloka_text: तस्मिन्प्रशासति तदा सर्वकामदुघा मही । रसवन्ति प्रभूनानि मूलानि च फलानि च ।। 7.84.7 ।।
transliteration: tasminpraśāsati tadā sarvakāmadughā mahī | rasavanti prabhūnāni mūlāni ca phalāni ca || 7.84.7 ||
translation: तस्मिन् when he, प्रशासति was ruling, तदा then, सर्वकामदुघा wish-fulfilling, मही the earth, रसवन्ति juicy, प्रभूनानि abundant, मूलानि roots, च and, फलानि fruits, च and.
explanation: While he was ruling, the earth became a wish-fulfilling cow, providing abundant and juicy roots and fruits.

shloka_text: अकृष्टपच्या पृथिवी सुसम्पन्ना महात्मनः । स राज्यं तादृशं भुङ्क्ते स्फीतमद्भुतदर्शनम् ।। 7.84.8 ।।
transliteration: akṛṣṭapacyā pṛthivī susampannā mahātmanaḥ | sa rājyaṃ tādṛśaṃ bhuṅkte sphītamadbhutadarśanam || 7.84.8 ||
translation: अकृष्टपच्या yielding crops without cultivation, पृथिवी the earth, सुसम्पन्ना well-endowed, महात्मनः of the great-souled one, सः he, राज्यम् kingdom, तादृशम् such, भुङ्क्ते enjoyed, स्फीतम् prosperous, अद्भुतदर्शनम् of wonderful appearance.
explanation: The earth, without cultivation, yielded abundant crops for that great-souled king, and he enjoyed such a prosperous and marvelous kingdom.

shloka_text: तस्य बुद्धिः समुप्तन्ना तपः कुर्यामनुत्तमम् । तपो हि परमं श्रेयः सम्मोहमितरत्सुखम् ।। 7.84.9 ।।
transliteration: tasya buddhiḥ samuptannā tapaḥ kuryāmanuttamam | tapo hi paramaṃ śreyaḥ sammohamitaratsukham || 7.84.9 ||
translation: तस्य his, बुद्धिः thought, समुप्तन्ना arose, तपः penance, कुर्याम् I should perform, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed, तपः penance, हि indeed, परमम् supreme, श्रेयः good, सम्मोहम् delusion, इतरत् other, सुखम् happiness.
explanation: A thought arose in his mind that he should perform unsurpassed penance, for indeed, penance is the supreme good, while other forms of happiness lead to delusion.

shloka_text: स निक्षिप्य सुतं ज्येष्ठं पौरेषु मधुरेश्वरम् । तप उग्रं समातिष्ठत्तापयन्सर्वदेवताः ।। 7.84.10 ।।
transliteration: sa nikṣipya sutaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ paureṣu madhureśvaram | tapa ugraṃ samātiṣṭhattāpayansarvadevatāḥ || 7.84.10 ||
translation: सः he, निक्षिप्य entrusting, सुतम् son, ज्येष्ठम् eldest, पौरेषु among the citizens, मधुरेश्वरम् Madhureśvara, तपः penance, उग्रम् severe, समातिष्ठत् undertook, तापयन् causing to suffer, सर्वदेवताः all deities.
explanation: He entrusted his eldest son, Madhureśvara, to the citizens and undertook severe penance, thereby causing all the deities to suffer.

shloka_text: तपस्तप्यति वृत्रे तु वासवः परमार्तवत् । विष्णुं समुपसङ्क्रम्य वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। 7.84.11 ।।
transliteration: tapastapyati vṛtre tu vāsavaḥ paramārtavat | viṣṇuṃ samupasaṅkramya vākyametaduvāca ha || 7.84.11 ||
translation: तपः penance, तप्यति performs, वृत्रे when Vritra, तु indeed, वासवः Indra, परमार्तवत् like one greatly distressed, विष्णुं to Vishnu, समुपसङ्क्रम्य having approached, वाक्यम् words, एतत् these, उवाच spoke, ह indeed.
explanation: When Vritra was performing penance, Indra, greatly distressed, approached Vishnu and spoke these words.

shloka_text: तपस्यता महाबाहो लोकाः वृत्रेण निर्जिताः । बलवान्स हि धर्मात्मा नैनं शक्ष्यामि शासितुम् ।। 7.84.12 ।।
transliteration: tapasyatā mahābāho lokāḥ vṛtreṇa nirjitāḥ | balavānsa hi dharmātmā nainaṃ śakṣyāmi śāsitum || 7.84.12 ||
translation: तपस्यता by the one performing penance, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, लोकाः the worlds, वृत्रेण by Vritra, निर्जिताः have been conquered, बलवान् powerful, सः he, हि indeed, धर्मात्मा righteous-souled, न not, एनं him, शक्ष्यामि I am able, शासितुम् to control.
explanation: O mighty-armed one, Vritra, who is performing penance, has conquered the worlds; he is indeed powerful and righteous, and I am unable to control him.

shloka_text: यद्यसौ तप आतिष्ठेद्भूय एवासुरेश्वर । यावल्लोका धरिष्यन्ति तावदस्य वशानुगाः ।। 7.84.13 ।।
transliteration: yadyasau tapa ātiṣṭhedbhūya evāsureśvara | yāvallokā dhariṣyanti tāvadasya vaśānugāḥ || 7.84.13 ||
translation: यदि if, असौ he, तपः penance, आतिष्ठेत् should perform, भूयः again, एव indeed, असुरेश्वर O lord of Asuras, यावत् as long as, लोकाः the worlds, धरिष्यन्ति will endure, तावत् so long, अस्य his, वशानुगाः subservient.
explanation: O Lord of Asuras, if he performs penance again, the worlds will remain subservient to him as long as they endure.

shloka_text: तं चैनं परमोदारमुपेक्षसि महाबलम् । क्षणं हि न भवेद्वृत्रः क्रुद्धे त्वयि सुरेश्वर ।। 7.84.14 ।।
transliteration: taṃ cainaṃ paramodāramupekṣasi mahābalam | kṣaṇaṃ hi na bhavedvṛtraḥ kruddhe tvayi sureśvara || 7.84.14 ||
translation: तं him, च and, एनं this one, परमोदारम् extremely powerful, उपेक्षसि you disregard, महाबलम् very powerful, क्षणं for a moment, हि indeed, न not, भवेत् would exist, वृत्रः Vritra, क्रुद्धे when angry, त्वयि you, सुरेश्वर O lord of gods.
explanation: And yet you disregard this extremely powerful Vritra; for indeed, Vritra would not exist even for a moment if you, O Lord of gods, were to become angry.

shloka_text: यदा हि प्रीतिसंयोगं त्वया विष्णो समागतः । तदाप्रभृति लोकानां नाथत्वमुपलब्धवान् ।। 7.84.15 ।।
transliteration: yadā hi prītisaṃyogaṃ tvayā viṣṇo samāgataḥ | tadāprabhṛti lokānāṃ nāthatvamupalabdhavān || 7.84.15 ||
translation: यदा when, हि indeed, प्रीतिसंयोगं union of affection, त्वया by you, विष्णो O Vishnu, समागतः he obtained, तदाप्रभृति from that time onwards, लोकानां of the worlds, नाथत्वम् lordship, उपलब्धवान् he obtained.
explanation: Indeed, it was when he obtained your favor, O Vishnu, that he achieved lordship over the worlds from that time onwards.

shloka_text: स त्वं प्रसादं लोकानां कुरुष्व सुसमाहितः । त्वत्कृतेन हि सर्वं स्याप्रशान्तमरुजं जगत् ।। 7.84.16 ।।
transliteration: sa tvaṃ prasādaṃ lokānāṃ kuruṣva susamāhitaḥ | tvatkṛtena hi sarvaṃ syāpraśāntamarujaṃ jagat || 7.84.16 ||
translation: स that, त्वं you, प्रसादं favor, लोकानां of the worlds, कुरुष्व do, सुसमाहितः well-composed, त्वत्कृतेन by your doing, हि indeed, सर्वं all, स्यात् would be, प्रशान्तम् peaceful, अरुजं free from suffering, जगत् world.
explanation: You, being well-composed, should bestow your favor upon the worlds, for by your action alone, the entire world would become peaceful and free from suffering.

shloka_text: इमे हि सर्वे विष्णो त्वां निरीक्षन्ते दिवौकसः । वृत्रघातेन महता तेषां साह्यं कुरुष्व ह ।। 7.84.17 ।।
transliteration: ime hi sarve viṣṇo tvāṃ nirīkṣante divaukasaḥ | vṛtraghātena mahatā teṣāṃ sāhyaṃ kuruṣva ha || 7.84.17 ||
translation: इमे these, हि indeed, सर्वे all, विष्णो O Vishnu, त्वां you, निरीक्षन्ते await, दिवौकसः gods, वृत्रघातेन by the slaying of Vritra, महता great, तेषां their, साह्यं help, कुरुष्व render, ह indeed.
explanation: O Vishnu, all these gods indeed await you; therefore, render them great help by slaying Vritra.

shloka_text: त्वया हि नित्यशः साह्यं कृतमेषां महात्मनाम् । असह्यमिदमन्येषामगतीनां गतिर्भवान् ।। 7.84.18 ।।
transliteration: tvayā hi nityaśaḥ sāhyaṃ kṛtameṣāṃ mahātmanām | asahyamidamanyeṣāmagatīnāṃ gatirbhavān || 7.84.18 ||
translation: त्वया by you, हि indeed, नित्यशः always, साह्यं help, कृतम् rendered, एषां of these, महात्मनाम् great-souled ones, असह्यम् unbearable, इदम् this, अन्येषाम् for others, अगतीनां of those without refuge, गतिः refuge, भवान् you.
explanation: Indeed, you have always rendered help to these great-souled ones, for this task is unbearable for others, and you are the sole refuge for the helpless. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे चतुरशीतितमः सर्गः ।। 84 ।। Thus ends the eighty-fourth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
